title: SXSW Dispatch: Everything About Hype-Associated AI Risk in One Video
subtitle: Live from sxsw
text:
Austin, Texas: this video was taken at SXSW. Notice the latency issue! So many people came to the OpenAI talk that they filled the room and the overflow room. And still— they still couldn’t get the A/V sync right.

AI: it is amazing. But the other details matter, sometimes than the underlying tech.

Recklessly share this newsletter with people.
